summary_en: This Phase 1/2 study is testing AZD9793, a T cell-engaging antibody that targets GPC3, in adults with GPC3-positive advanced or metastatic solid tumours; the registered condition is hepatocellular carcinoma. It is given as an intravenous (IV) infusion or as a subcutaneous (SC) injection, and how long or how often is not stated. The study aims to determine whether the treatment is safe, tolerable and has anti-cancer activity.
summary_es: Este estudio de fase 1/2 evalúa AZD9793, un anticuerpo que activa las células T y se dirige a GPC3, en adultos con tumores sólidos avanzados o metastásicos que son positivos para GPC3; el tipo de cáncer registrado es carcinoma hepatocelular. Se administra por vía intravenosa (IV) en infusión o por vía subcutánea (SC) en inyección; la duración o la frecuencia no se indica en el registro. El estudio busca determinar si el tratamiento es seguro, tolerable y tiene actividad contra el cáncer.
who_for: Confirmed advanced, metastatic or unresectable liver cancer (HCC), proven by pathology.
Tumour tests GPC3 positive by central laboratory testing.
BCLC stage B (not eligible for locoregional therapy) or stage C, with Child-Pugh class A.
ECOG 0-1 and predicted life expectancy of 12 weeks or more.
not_for: Unresolved toxicity from prior cancer therapy at grade 2 or higher, with listed exceptions.
CAR-T cell therapy within the last 6 months.
Requires chronic immunosuppressive therapy, including prednisone above 10 mg daily.
Radiation within 14 days or major surgery within 14 days before first dose.
History of HLH or MAS, or a thromboembolic event within the past 3 months.
